name: Cisco Catalyst TA Tools
description: MCP tools for querying Cisco Catalyst Add-on API, syslog, and beta IOS-XE CLI collection
author: cisco-catalyst-ta-setup skill

tools.name: cisco_catalyst_check_health
tools.title: Cisco Catalyst Health Check
tools.description: Check recent Cisco Catalyst TA data by index and sourcetype, including generic endpoint and report outputs.
tools.spl: | tstats count as events max(_time) as last_event_epoch where index IN (catalyst,ise,sdwan,cybervision) by index sourcetype | eval last_event=strftime(last_event_epoch, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z"), age_seconds=now()-last_event_epoch | sort index sourcetype | fields index sourcetype events last_event age_seconds
examples: How many events are being collected?

tools.name: cisco_catalyst_collection_status
tools.title: Cisco Catalyst Collection Status
tools.description: Show the latest structured poll status for each Catalyst TA input instance.
tools.spl: index=_internal sourcetype IN ("splunktaciscodnacenter:log","splunktaciscocybervision:log","splunktaciscoise:log","splunktaciscosdwan:log","splunktaciscocli:log") event=poll-complete product IN ("Cisco-Catalyst-Center","Cisco-Cyber-Vision","Cisco-ISE","Cisco-SD-WAN","Cisco-IOS-XE-CLI") input=cisco_catalyst_* | stats latest(status) as status latest(records) as records latest(duration_ms) as duration_ms latest(_time) as last_poll_epoch by product instance input account | eval last_poll=strftime(last_poll_epoch, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z") | sort product instance | fields product instance input account status records duration_ms last_poll
examples: Which Catalyst input polled most recently?

tools.name: cisco_catalyst_list_inputs
tools.title: Cisco Catalyst List Inputs
tools.description: List all configured data inputs for the Cisco Catalyst TA with their status.
tools.spl: | rest /services/data/inputs/all count=0 | search eai:acl.app="TA_cisco_catalyst" | table title, eai:acl.app, disabled, index | sort title

tools.name: cisco_catalyst_dnac_issues
tools.title: Catalyst Center Issues
tools.description: Show recent Catalyst Center (DNA Center) issues and assurance alerts.
tools.spl: index=catalyst sourcetype="cisco:dnac:issue" | spath | stats count by name, priority, status, siteHierarchy | sort -count

tools.name: cisco_catalyst_dnac_device_health
tools.title: Catalyst Center Device Health
tools.description: Show device health scores from Catalyst Center.
tools.spl: index=catalyst sourcetype="cisco:dnac:devicehealth" | stats latest(OverallHealth) as health_score latest(CPUUtilization) as cpu_percent latest(MemoryUtilization) as memory_percent latest(ImageVersion) as image_version by DeviceName Platform DeviceRole | sort health_score
examples: Which devices have low health scores?

tools.name: cisco_catalyst_dnac_compliance
tools.title: Catalyst Center Compliance
tools.description: Show device compliance status from Catalyst Center.
tools.spl: index=catalyst sourcetype="cisco:dnac:compliance" | spath | stats count by complianceStatus, deviceName | sort -count

tools.name: cisco_catalyst_dnac_security_advisories
tools.title: Catalyst Center Security Advisories
tools.description: Show security advisories (PSIRTs) from Catalyst Center.
tools.spl: index=catalyst sourcetype="cisco:dnac:securityadvisory" | spath | stats count by advisoryId, sir, detectionType | sort -sir

tools.name: cisco_catalyst_ise_auth_summary
tools.title: ISE Authentication Summary
tools.description: Summarize ISE authentication events by status and policy.
tools.spl: index=ise sourcetype="cisco:ise*" | stats count by sourcetype, _time | timechart span=1h count by sourcetype

tools.name: cisco_catalyst_sdwan_bfd
tools.title: Cisco SD-WAN BFD API Collection
tools.description: Summarize BFD summary, synchronized-session, and history events collected through the SD-WAN API Endpoint Collection input.
tools.spl: index=sdwan sourcetype IN ("cisco:sdwan:custom:device_bfd_summary","cisco:sdwan:custom:device_bfd_synced_sessions","cisco:sdwan:custom:device_bfd_history") | stats count latest(_time) as last_event_epoch values(endpoint_path) as endpoint_path by sourcetype target_device_id | eval last_event=strftime(last_event_epoch, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z"), age_seconds=now()-last_event_epoch | sort sourcetype target_device_id | fields sourcetype target_device_id endpoint_path count last_event age_seconds
examples: Which WAN Edge devices have current BFD API records?

tools.name: cisco_catalyst_sdwan_syslog_status
tools.title: Cisco SD-WAN Text-Syslog Status
tools.description: Summarize UTD, traditional ZBFW, and ordinary IOS-XE text-syslog events after cisco:firewall:logs ingress routing. HSL and Unified Logging are separate NetFlow/IPFIX paths.
tools.spl: | tstats count as events max(_time) as last_event_epoch where index=* sourcetype IN ("cisco:firewall:logs","cisco:sdwan:utd:logs","cisco:sdwan:session:audit:trail:start","cisco:sdwan:session:audit:trail","cisco:sdwan:pass:pkt","cisco:sdwan:drop:pkt","cisco:sdwan:log:summary","cisco:sdwan:block:host","cisco:sdwan:unblock:host","cisco:sdwan:alert:on","cisco:sdwan:alert:off","cisco:sdwan:host:tcp:alert:on","cisco:sdwan:sessions:maximum","cisco:sdwan:acl:logs","cisco:sdwan:sgacl:logs","cisco:sdwan:syslog","cisco:sdwan:system:logs") by index sourcetype | eval collection_path=case(sourcetype="cisco:sdwan:utd:logs","UTD external text syslog", in(sourcetype,"cisco:sdwan:syslog","cisco:sdwan:system:logs","cisco:sdwan:acl:logs","cisco:sdwan:sgacl:logs"),"IOS-XE system/ACL text syslog", sourcetype="cisco:firewall:logs","Unsplit ingress", true(),"Traditional ZBFW text syslog") | eval last_event=strftime(last_event_epoch, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z"), age_seconds=now()-last_event_epoch | sort collection_path sourcetype | fields index collection_path sourcetype events last_event age_seconds
examples: Are UTD and ZBFW text events reaching Splunk?

tools.name: cisco_catalyst_iosxe_cli_status
tools.title: Cisco IOS-XE CLI Beta Status
tools.description: Show recent bounded direct-device CLI snapshots by command and device.
tools.spl: index=* sourcetype=cisco:iosxe:cli:* | stats count latest(_time) as last_event_epoch latest(exit_status) as exit_status by index host sourcetype command_id command | eval last_event=strftime(last_event_epoch, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z"), age_seconds=now()-last_event_epoch | sort host command_id | fields index host sourcetype command_id command exit_status count last_event age_seconds
examples: Which cataloged commands have returned data?

tools.name: cisco_catalyst_cybervision_vulnerabilities
tools.title: Cyber Vision Vulnerabilities
tools.description: Show OT vulnerabilities detected by Cisco Cyber Vision.
tools.spl: index=cybervision sourcetype="cisco:cybervision:vulnerabilities" | spath | stats count by cveId, severity, component | sort -severity
